headline: AI Agents Get Wallets: The New Payment Frontier
summary: Major tech platforms are embedding payment capabilities directly into AI agents, turning them into autonomous economic actors. This shift demands new security models, policy engines, and developer guardrails for AI-initiated transactions.

slides.title: AI Agents Are Getting Their Own Wallets
slides.subtitle: Autonomous spending is no longer sci-fi—it's shipping.
slides.body: Major platforms are embedding payment rails into AI agents. How much financial autonomy should we grant them?
slides.deep_dive: Apple, Google, and OpenAI are integrating wallet APIs that let AI agents initiate transactions on behalf of users. This shifts AI from advisory to autonomous economic actors, requiring new guardrails for spending limits, authentication, and audit trails.
slides.key_fact: AI-initiated transactions are moving from demos to production APIs.
slides.why_it_matters: Engineers must design authorization frameworks for non-human spenders.

slides.title: Convergence of LLMs, Payment Rails, and Identity
slides.body: Mature language models, tokenized payment networks, and verifiable credentials now allow agents to act as trusted financial proxies.

slides.title: How an Agent Pays: The Authorization Flow
slides.body: From user intent to settled transaction—guardrails at every step.

steps.title: User Sets Policy
steps.desc: Define spending caps, merchant categories, and approval thresholds.

steps.title: Agent Proposes Action
steps.desc: AI evaluates context and suggests a payment within policy.

steps.title: Policy Engine Validates
steps.desc: Automated checks enforce limits, velocity, and anomaly detection.

steps.title: User Confirms (Optional)
steps.desc: High-value or novel transactions request explicit consent.

steps.title: Execution & Audit
steps.desc: Payment executes via tokenized rails; immutable log recorded.

slides.title: Incumbents vs. New Entrants
slides.body: Platform wallets embed AI; startups build agent-first financial infrastructure.
left_items: OpenAI: Function calling with payment plugins
Fintech: Embedded finance APIs for agents

slides.title: Architecting Guardrails for Autonomous Agents
slides.body: Treat agent payments like privileged microservices—least privilege, observability, and rollback.

slides.title: AI Wallets Are the New App Store Moment
slides.body: Financial autonomy for agents unlocks new product categories—if we build trust first.
takeaways: Design policy engines before enabling agent spend.
Adopt verifiable credentials for agent identity.
Plan for audit trails from day one.
